description: This file contains a collection of utility functions related to retrieving and calculating properties of instruments used in the JWST data analysis pipeline, such as amplifier configurations, frame timing, observation times, and instrument-specific parameters.

methods.name: amplifier_info(filename, omit_reference_pixels=True)
methods.description: Determines the number of amplifiers used to read out a given FITS file and computes amplifier boundary coordinates based on instrument-specific configurations and reference pixel omission.

methods.name: calc_frame_time(instrument, aperture, xdim, ydim, amps, sample_time=1.e-5)
methods.description: Calculates the readout time for a frame with specified dimensions, instrument, and number of amplifiers, accounting for instrument-specific readout characteristics.

methods.name: get_obstime(filename)
methods.description: Extracts the observation date and time from the FITS header of a file.

methods.name: mean_time(times)
methods.description: Computes the mean of a list of datetime objects.

ctags.name: calc_frame_time
ctags.pattern: /^def calc_frame_time(instrument, aperture, xdim, ydim, amps, sample_time=1.e-5):$/
